name: Customer base
description: The people or organisations you sell to or serve. Includes their geography, size, and how they pay you.

name: Suppliers and vendors
description: The third parties you depend on for goods, services, software, or infrastructure.

name: Employees and contractors
description: Anyone who works for you, including subcontractors and seasonal staff.

name: Payment-in channels
description: How money comes in: card, bank transfer, cash, marketplace payouts, invoicing.

name: Payment-out channels
description: How money leaves: payroll, supplier transfers, expense reimbursement, refunds.

name: Customer + employee data
description: Personal data and other sensitive records you hold.

name: Core IT systems
description: The applications, devices, and cloud accounts your business depends on day-to-day.

name: Regulatory perimeter
description: The licences, registrations, tax filings, and supervisory relationships your business depends on.

name: Reputation and brand
description: Public perception of your business — reviews, press, social media, complaints.
